summary: Comprehensive testing of SRDFSIL Portuguese recreational society website. All backend APIs (23 tests) passed. All frontend pages load correctly with proper navigation, forms, and admin functionality working as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: TEST_Gallery Item shows broken image placeholder (test data with invalid URL)

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Auth uses JWT with httpOnly cookies - secure implementation
All forms have proper validation and error handling
Admin dashboard properly protects routes and checks user role
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin user, 3 sample events, and 3 sample gallery items on startup
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Backend API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_api.py cover auth, events CRUD, gallery CRUD, member registration, and contact form. Frontend tested with Playwright covering homepage, events page with filters, contact form, member registration, gallery with lightbox, admin login, and admin dashboard with all tabs (events, gallery, members, contacts).

homepage.details: Hero section, stats strip, upcoming events, CTA section all working

navigation.details: All menu links work correctly (Início, A Nossa História, Eventos, Serviços, Galeria, Contactos)

events_page.details: Events display from API, filter buttons (Todos/Próximos/Passados) work correctly

contact_form.details: Form submission works, success message displayed

member_registration.details: Form submission works, success message displayed, duplicate email rejected

gallery_page.details: Images display from API, lightbox opens/closes correctly

admin_login.details: Login with admin@srdfsil.pt / admin123 works, redirects to dashboard

admin_events_crud.details: Create, edit, delete events all working

admin_gallery_management.details: Add and delete gallery items working

historia_page.details: Timeline section and content display correctly

servicos_page.details: All services (Teatro, Desporto, Salão) display correctly
